# Set Up
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(blockCV)
library(dismo)

source(here::here("3-scripts", "1-functions.r"))

trg_crs <- "EPSG:6440"
```

# Load Data

```{r}

p <- readRDS(here::here('2-data', 'processed', 'oys_proc.rds'))

r_depth <- rast(here::here("2-data", "rasters", "rast_depth.tif"))
r_do <- rast(here::here("2-data", "rasters", "rast_do.tif"))
r_sal <-rast(here::here("2-data", "rasters", "rast_sal.tif"))
r_sed <-rast(here::here("2-data", "rasters", "rast_sed.tif"))
r_turb <-rast(here::here("2-data", "rasters", "rast_turb.tif"))
r_wTemp <-rast(here::here("2-data", "rasters", "rast_wTemp.tif"))

r_stack <- c(r_depth, r_do, r_sal, r_sed, r_turb, r_wTemp)

names(r_stack) <- c(
  "Depth",
  "Dissolved Oxygen",
  "Salinity",
  "Sediment",
  "Turbidity",
  "Water Temperature"
)

plot(r_stack)

```

# Prepare Point Data

## Species Occurance 

```{r}
#| label: load-and-prepare-oyster-data

p <- p %>%
  mutate(
    pb = 1,
    x = st_coordinates(p)[, "X"],
    y = st_coordinates(p)[, "Y"],
  ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      pb,
      x,
      y,
      geometry
    ) %>%
      st_transform(crs = trg_crs)

sa <- get_study_area()
sa <- st_transform(sa, crs = trg_crs)

plot(st_geometry(sa))

points(
  st_geometry(p),
  pch = 1
)
```

## Species Background Points

```{r}
sa_vector <- terra::vect(sa) %>%
  terra::project(
    trg_crs
  )

mask <- terra::rasterize(
  sa_vector,
  r_stack[[1]],
  field = 0,
  background = NA,
  touches = TRUE
)

mask <- raster::raster(mask)

terra::plot(mask)

p_xy <- st_coordinates(p)[, c("X", "Y"), drop = FALSE]

set.seed(42)

b <- randomPoints(
  mask = mask,
  n = 500,
  p = p_xy
)

b <- b %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("x", "y"),
    crs = trg_crs
  )
```


#### Map P-Bg Points
```{r}
#| Draw-map
tmap::tmap_mode("plot")

tmap::tm_shape(mask) +
  tmap::tm_raster(
    col.scale = tmap::tm_scale(values = "grey90"),
    col.legend = tmap::tm_legend_hide()
  ) +
  tmap::tm_shape(sa) +
  tmap::tm_borders(col = "black", lwd = 1.5) +
  tmap::tm_shape(p) +
  tmap::tm_symbols(
    fill = "red",
    col = "red",
    shape = 16,
    size = 0.50
  ) +
  tmap::tm_shape(b) +
  tmap::tm_symbols(
    fill = NA,
    col = "black",
    shape = 16,
    size = 0.50
  ) +
  tmap::tm_layout(
    frame = FALSE,
    legend.show = FALSE
  )

```

## Create final data inputs 

```{r}
#| label: final-prep-for-model

# Convert terra predictors to raster::RasterStack
r_stack <- raster::stack(r_stack)

p_coordinates <- sf::st_coordinates(p)

# Create single presence - background dataset
p_xy <- data.frame(
  x = p_coordinates[,"X"],
  y = p_coordinates[, "Y"],
  pb = 1
) %>%
  sf::st_as_sf(
    coords = c("x", "y"),
    crs = trg_crs
  )

b_coordinates <- sf::st_coordinates(b)

b_xy <- data.frame(
  x = b_coordinates[, "X"],
  y = b_coordinates[, "Y"],
  pb = 0
) %>%
  sf::st_as_sf(
    coords = c("x", "y"),
    crs = trg_crs
  )

pb <- rbind(
  p_xy,
  b_xy
)
```

# Determine Spatial Auto Correlation 
```{r}
#| label: determine autocorrelation

cor_stack <- c(r_depth, r_sal, r_turb, r_wTemp)

names(cor_stack) <- c("Depth", "Salinity", "Turbidity", "Water Temperature")

r_cor <- cv_spatial_autocor(
  r = cor_stack,
  num_sample = 5000,
  plot = TRUE,
  progress = TRUE
)

p_cor <- cv_spatial_autocor(
  x = pb,
  column = "pb",
  plot = TRUE,
  progress = TRUE
)

p_cor$range
p_cor$range_table

```

```{r}
block_sizes <- c(2500, 5000, 7500, 10000, 12500)


# Create folds
spatial_folds <- purrr::map(
  block_sizes,
  ~blockCV::cv_spatial(
    x = cv_pts,
    column = "pb",
    r = rast(mask),
    k = 5,
    size = .x, 
    selection = "random",
    iteration = 1000,
    balance = TRUE,
    presence_bg = TRUE,
    seed = 42,
    progress = TRUE,
    report = TRUE,
    plot = TRUE
  )
)

spatial_folds <- blockCV::cv_spatial(
  x = cv_pts,
  column = "pb",
  r = rast(mask),
  k = 5,
  size = 5000,
  selection = "random",
  iteration = 1000,
  balance = TRUE,
  presence_bg = TRUE,
  seed = 42,
  progress = TRUE,
  report = TRUE,
  plot = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
folds <- spatial_folds$folds_list

cv_models <- vector("list", length(folds))
cv_evals  <- vector("list", length(folds))
cv_results <- vector("list", length(folds))

for (i in seq_along(folds)) {

  train_idx <- folds[[i]][[1]]
  test_idx  <- folds[[i]][[2]]

  train_sf <- cv_pts[train_idx, ]
  test_sf  <- cv_pts[test_idx, ]

  p_train <- sf::st_coordinates(
    train_sf[train_sf$pb == 1, ]
  )

  a_train <- sf::st_coordinates(
    train_sf[train_sf$pb == 0, ]
  )

  p_test <- sf::st_coordinates(
    test_sf[test_sf$pb == 1, ]
  )

  a_test <- sf::st_coordinates(
    test_sf[test_sf$pb == 0, ]
  )

  m <- dismo::maxent(
    x = predictors_raster,
    p = p_train,
    a = a_train,
    factors = "sediment",
    removeDuplicates = FALSE
  )

  e <- dismo::evaluate(
    p = p_test,
    a = a_test,
    model = m,
    x = predictors_raster
  )

  cv_models[[i]] <- m
  cv_evals[[i]] <- e

  cv_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
    fold = i,
    train_presence = nrow(p_train),
    test_presence = nrow(p_test),
    train_background = nrow(a_train),
    test_background = nrow(a_test),
    auc = e@auc
  )
}

cv_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(cv_results)
cv_results

```

```{r}
cv_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  cv_results
)

cv_results

cv_summary <- cv_results %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_auc = mean(auc),
    sd_auc = sd(auc),
    min_auc = min(auc),
    max_auc = max(auc)
  )

cv_summary

```

```{r}
final_model <- dismo::maxent(
  x = predictors_raster,
  p = occ_xy,
  a = bg,
  factors = "sediment",

)

```

```{r}

suitability <- raster::predict(
  final_model,
  predictors_raster
)

suitability <- rast(
  suitability
)

crs(suitability) <- target_crs

names(suitability) <- "maxent_suitability"
```

```{r}

# plot showing importance of each variable
plot(me)

# response curves
response(me)

# predict to entire dataset
r <- predict(me, predictors_raster) 

#testing
# background data
bg <- randomPoints(predictors_raster, 10000)

#simplest way to use 'evaluate'
e1 <- evaluate(me, p=occtest, a=bg, x=predictors_raster)

# alternative 1
# extract values
pvtest <- data.frame(extract(predictors_raster, occtest))
avtest <- data.frame(extract(predictors_raster, bg))

e2 <- evaluate(me, p=pvtest, a=avtest)
e2

# alternative 2 
# predict to testing points 
testp <- predict(me, pvtest) 
head(testp)
testa <- predict(me, avtest) 

e3 <- evaluate(p=testp, a=testa)
e3
threshold(e3)

plot(e3, 'ROC')

crs(pred) <- "ESRI:103021"
crs(r) <- "ESRI:103021"


```
